info.name: HASH '27 API
info.description:
REST API for HASH '27 TechFest (MBCET).

Run folders top-to-bottom (or use the Collection Runner): 01 Auth logs in and stores the JWT in {{token}}; 03 Events creates a temporary event that 04 Registrations uses; 99 Cleanup removes it.

Set the environment (baseUrl, adminUsername, adminPassword) from HASH27.local.postman_environment.json.

request.description: Liveness + database state. 503 when Mongo is down.
Run this first. The token is stored in the {{token}} collection variable and used by every admin request.
Changes the password and immediately changes it back, so the collection stays re-runnable.

exec: body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ currentPassword: pm.variables.get('newAdminPassword'), newPassword: pm.variables.get('adminPassword') }) }
}, (e, res) => pm.test('Password reverted so later runs still work', () => { pm.expect(e).to.be.null; pm.expect(res.code).to.eql(200); }));

request.description: Public account for attendees, separate from the organiser admin login. Token stored in {{userToken}}.
Uses {{userToken}}, not the admin {{token}} - the two are different JWT types and are rejected on each other's routes (see next two requests).

item.name: Admin token rejected on user route

request.description: Admin and user tokens carry different `typ` claims and cannot be swapped.

item.name: User token rejected on admin route
Register while logged in (linked to account)

request.description: Sending the user token on a registration links it to the account; anonymous registration (no token) still works everywhere else in this collection.

item.name: Update settings (set a deadline, then clear it)

request.description: Sets a far-future deadline (registration stays open). Send null to remove a deadline.
Used by the Events and Register pages.
Creates a throw-away event used by the Registrations folder. Removed again in 99 Cleanup.
Phone accepts +91 / spaces and is normalised to 10 digits.
Capacity is 2, so the third registration is rejected.

exec: pm.test('Field-level messages', () => { const f = pm.response.json().error.details.map(d => d.field); pm.expect(f).to.include.members(['name','email','phone','year']); });
pm.test('Two registrations for the test event', () => pm.expect(j.meta.total).to.eql(2));
pm.test('Updated', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.department).to.eql('ECE'); pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('attended'); });
pm.test('1 seat taken, 1 free', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.registeredCount).to.eql(1); pm.expect(d.seatsLeft).to.eql(1); });

item.name: Register user C again -> now fits

request.description: In Postman use Send and Download to save the file. Opens correctly in Excel (UTF-8 BOM).
Two seats are taken (A and C), so capacity cannot drop to 1.

exec: pm.test('Sections with members', () => { const s = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(s).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; pm.expect(s[0]).to.include.keys('key','title','patron','members'); });
pm.test('Tiers with sponsors', () => { const t = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(t).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; pm.expect(t[0]).to.include.keys('key','title','sponsors'); });

request.description: Form-data field must be named 'image'. Run the collection with the postman/ folder as working dir (npm run postman does), or pick postman/sample.png manually.

item.name: 99 Cleanup
item.description: Removes everything the QA flow created so the collection can be re-run.
